faceplates.name: AV Room Controller
faceplates.description: A room at a glance: source, display power, volume and mute, with mic, fault and online indicators. Bind whichever joins carry them.

faceplates.name: Circulation Pump Set
faceplates.description: Circulator set, one to four pumps, hot or chilled service. The service recolours the pipework rather than needing a second drawing.
faceplates.emulates: Hot or chilled water circulation pump set

faceplates.name: Circutor CVM-E3-MINI
faceplates.description: Panel-mount three-phase analyser: negative LCD with three stacked values, magnitude and unit to the right, four-key bezel.

faceplates.name: Compound Water Meter
faceplates.description: Two registers on one body — main turbine and low-flow bypass — kept apart, because a bypass climbing alone is how a leak shows.
faceplates.emulates: Compound water meter with main and bypass registers

faceplates.name: Daikin BRC1E63
faceplates.description: Wired navigation controller: landscape LCD with mode, clock, set point and room temperature, over four pill keys and a navigation pad.
faceplates.emulates: Daikin BRC1E63 / BRC1E53 navigation remote controller

faceplates.name: Daikin BRC1H63K (Madoka)
faceplates.description: Round wall controller with an illuminated status ring and a dark display. Mode, room temperature and three touch keys.

faceplates.name: Daikin BRC2E61
faceplates.description: Simplified wired controller: a small central display surrounded by large flat keys for power, temperature, fan and louvre.

faceplates.name: Daikin BRC315D7
faceplates.description: Schedule controller, cover closed: wide segmented display with timer rows, temperature and mode icons.

faceplates.name: Dial Water Meter
faceplates.description: Domestic dial face: an odometer window for whole cubic metres and a single sweep hand for the lowest decade.

faceplates.name: DIN-rail 3-phase analyser
faceplates.description: Portrait DIN-mounted analyser with a stacked per-phase display. Generic to the form factor, not modelled on a specific product.

faceplates.name: Exhaust Fan
faceplates.description: Exhaust fan discharging to atmosphere, air drawn upward.

faceplates.name: Fan Coil Unit
faceplates.description: Compact status tile for a BMS fan coil: room against setpoint, mode, fan and alarm. Built to tile, because sites have hundreds.

faceplates.name: Generic 3-phase meter
faceplates.description: Single-page readout for boards where the physical meter is unknown.

faceplates.name: Fire Indicator Panel (schematic)
faceplates.description: Zone and status mimic of a fire panel as the BMS sees it. Schematic on purpose — it must never be mistaken for the panel itself.
faceplates.emulates: Generic fire indicator panel (not a specific make)

faceplates.name: Hot Water Unit
faceplates.description: Calorifier set with flow and return drawn separately — the pair of temperatures is the diagnosis. One unit or a duty/standby pair.

faceplates.name: LCD Water Meter
faceplates.description: Electronic register: cumulative total, instantaneous flow and a battery bar, on a grey-green LCD.

faceplates.name: Multi-jet water register
faceplates.description: Mechanical register: seven-digit odometer over four sweep dials, all reading one cumulative total.

faceplates.name: Pool Plant
faceplates.description: Pool heating and circulation. Water temperature is the hero; heater, solar and filter pump explain why it is what it is. Read-only — stack the mode selects and setpoint numbers underneath, which Home Assistant's own rows do better than a drawing. Pair with a water meter faceplate for consumption.

faceplates.name: Q-SYS Zone Rack
faceplates.description: One strip per audio zone: level bar in dB, mute with an indicator, and trim keys. Widens to the number of zones you set.

faceplates.name: Schneider EasyLogic PM2200
faceplates.description: Square panel-mount analyser: pale LCD with a title band, four labelled rows and a soft-key legend over four push keys.

faceplates.name: Smart Water Meter
faceplates.description: Electronic register with the flags these meters raise: leak, reverse flow and battery. Clear annunciators show nothing, not dashes.
faceplates.emulates: Smart water meter with leak and reverse-flow detection

faceplates.name: Water Storage Tanks
faceplates.description: One to four storage tanks side by side against a shared scale, because a tank farm is read by comparing tanks. High-level alarms sit at the top of each tank where the float is. Roles are tank1_level, tank1_high_alarm, tank1_low_alarm and so on, plus a shared pressure.

faceplates.name: Supply Fan — in from left
faceplates.description: Supply fan with the duct entering from the left. Arrows follow the air, so the mimic cannot be read backwards.

faceplates.name: Supply Fan — in from right
faceplates.description: Supply fan with the duct entering from the right. Arrows follow the air, so the mimic cannot be read backwards.

faceplates.name: Supply Fan — in from top
faceplates.description: Supply fan with the duct entering from the top. Arrows follow the air, so the mimic cannot be read backwards.

faceplates.name: Under-bench Freezer
faceplates.description: Under-counter freezer, 1-6 doors or 1-8 drawers. Temperature against its -26 to -12 °C band is the primary reading; door, compressor and alarm are lamps. Doors and drawers are drawn to identify the cabinet, not bound separately — a real unit has one door switch for the whole thing.

faceplates.name: Under-bench Fridge
faceplates.description: Under-counter refrigerator, 1-6 doors or 1-8 drawers. Temperature against its 0 to 8 °C band is the primary reading; door, compressor and alarm are lamps. Doors and drawers are drawn to identify the cabinet, not bound separately — a real unit has one door switch for the whole thing.

faceplates.name: Upright Freezer
faceplates.description: Upright reach-in freezer. Temperature against its -26 to -12 °C band is the primary reading; door, compressor and alarm are lamps. Doors and drawers are drawn to identify the cabinet, not bound separately — a real unit has one door switch for the whole thing.

faceplates.name: Upright Fridge
faceplates.description: Upright reach-in refrigerator. Temperature against its 0 to 8 °C band is the primary reading; door, compressor and alarm are lamps. Doors and drawers are drawn to identify the cabinet, not bound separately — a real unit has one door switch for the whole thing.

faceplates.name: Vertical multistage pump set
faceplates.description: Packaged booster skid: vertical multistage pumps on a common manifold with a bladder vessel and control panel. Choose how many pumps.

faceplates.name: Walk-in Freezer
faceplates.description: Walk-in freezer room. Temperature against its -26 to -12 °C band is the primary reading; door, compressor and alarm are lamps. Doors and drawers are drawn to identify the cabinet, not bound separately — a real unit has one door switch for the whole thing.

faceplates.name: Walk-in Fridge
faceplates.description: Walk-in cold room. Temperature against its 0 to 8 °C band is the primary reading; door, compressor and alarm are lamps. Doors and drawers are drawn to identify the cabinet, not bound separately — a real unit has one door switch for the whole thing.

faceplates.name: Woltmann Bulk Register
faceplates.description: Straight-reading bulk register: black cells for whole cubic metres, red for the decimals, with a sweep hand on the lowest decade.

faceplates.name: Zone Mixer (console)
faceplates.description: Channel strips side by side with vertical faders: source, optional EQ, pan, fader, mute and a scribble strip. Click a fader to move it.
